prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Houston, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1209; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving through the intersection in Houston, Texas, heading east on a two-lane road with a green light.
Q: What happened as you entered the intersection?
A: A pickup came from my right side and ran the red light. I saw it too late to brake. It hit the passenger side of my car.
Q: Were you able to stop or swerve at all?
A: I tapped the brakes, but there wasn't time. The impact pushed my car sideways.
Q: Did you hit anything else during the collision?
A: No, just the curb on the far corner after the car spun a little.
Q: Did you receive any medical attention?
A: Yes, an ambulance took me to the emergency room. They said I have a shoulder injury and gave me a sling.
Q: Which shoulder, and what symptoms are you experiencing now?
A: My left shoulder. It's sore, I have limited range of motion, and I've had trouble sleeping on that side.
Q: Have you seen a doctor since then?
A: Yes, I have an appointment with an orthopedist next week for a follow-up.
Q: Was anyone else in your vehicle?
A: No, I was alone.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was following the traffic laws and the other driver admitted to running the light at the scene.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Thank you.
